queries.name: node_chart
queries.sql:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT hex(SHA256(toString(tuple(project_id,source_id,resource_id,resource_kind,host_id,device_id,
    resource_present,scope_present,scope_name,scope_version,resource_schema_url,scope_schema_url,
    metric_name,unit,metric_kind,temporality,monotonic,
    arraySort(a -> a.1, arrayMap(a -> tuple(a.path,a.kind,a.string_value,a.int_value,
    if(isNull(a.double_value),NULL,reinterpretAsUInt64(assumeNotNull(a.double_value))),
    a.bool_value,a.bytes_value), arrayFilter(a -> a.path NOT IN ('/recount.host.boot_id','/recount.collection.epoch_id'), resource_attributes))),
    arraySort(a -> a.1, arrayMap(a -> tuple(a.path,a.kind,a.string_value,a.int_value,
    if(isNull(a.double_value),NULL,reinterpretAsUInt64(assumeNotNull(a.double_value))),
    a.bool_value,a.bytes_value), scope_attributes)),
    arraySort(a -> a.1, arrayMap(a -> tuple(a.path,a.kind,a.string_value,a.int_value,
    if(isNull(a.double_value),NULL,reinterpretAsUInt64(assumeNotNull(a.double_value))),
    a.bool_value,a.bytes_value), arrayFilter(a -> a.path NOT IN ('/recount.counter.segment_id'), point_attributes))))))) AS id,
    hex(stream_id) AS segment, metric_name AS metric, unit, host_id AS hostId,
    arrayFirst(a -> a.path='/cpu.mode' AND a.kind=2,point_attributes).string_value AS cpuMode,
    time_unix_nano, sample_id, flags,
    if(bitAnd(flags,1)=0,int_value,NULL) AS integer_value,
    if(bitAnd(flags,1)=0,double_value,NULL) AS scalar_double,
    intDiv(time_unix_nano-{from:UInt64},{step:UInt64}) AS bucket
  FROM metric_points FINAL
  WHERE project_id={project:String} AND source_id={source:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
    AND ({allHosts:UInt8}=1 OR host_id={host:String})
    AND resource_kind=1
    AND arrayExists(a -> a.path='/recount.collection.scope' AND a.kind=2 AND a.string_value='node',resource_attributes)
    AND ((metric_name='recount.node.cpu.time' AND unit='s' AND metric_kind=2 AND temporality=2 AND monotonic=1)
      OR (metric_name IN ('recount.node.memory.total','recount.node.memory.available') AND unit='By' AND metric_kind=1))
    AND (bitAnd(flags,1)!=0 OR (isNull(int_value) AND double_value>=0)
      OR (isNull(double_value) AND int_value>=0))
)
SELECT id,segment,metric,unit,hostId,cpuMode,
  toString({from:UInt64}+bucket*{step:UInt64}) AS bucketNs,
  argMax(tuple(toString(time_unix_nano),if(isNull(integer_value),NULL,toString(integer_value)),scalar_double,flags),
    tuple(time_unix_nano,sample_id)) AS sample
FROM samples GROUP BY id,segment,metric,unit,hostId,cpuMode,bucket

queries.name: gauge_by_node
queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT series_id AS series, stream_id AS stream,
    source_id AS g0,
    time_unix_nano AS t, sample_id,
    intDiv(time_unix_nano, {step:UInt64}) * {step:UInt64} AS bucket, if(bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0,
    if(isNull(int_value), double_value, toFloat64(int_value)), NULL) AS v
  FROM metric_points FINAL
  WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
    AND metric_name = {p0:String} AND CAST(metric_kind, 'Int16') = {p1:Int16}
),
per_series AS (
  SELECT series, g0, bucket, avg(v) AS value FROM base WHERE v IS NOT NULL GROUP BY series, g0, bucket
),
combined AS (
  SELECT g0, bucket, avg(value) AS value,
    NULL AS low, NULL AS high, count(per_series.value) AS sources
  FROM per_series GROUP BY g0, bucket
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY weight DESC, g0) AS rank
  FROM (SELECT *, sum(abs(value)) OVER (PARTITION BY g0) AS weight FROM combined)
)
SELECT g0 AS k_g0, 0 AS other, toString(bucket) AS bucket_ns, value AS series_value, rank AS series_rank,
  low AS series_low, high AS series_high, sources AS series_sources
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= {seriesLimit:UInt32} + 1

queries.name: counter_rate_by_execution
queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT series_id AS series, stream_id AS stream,
    arrayJoin(if(empty(execution_keys), [NULL], arrayMap(k -> toNullable(k), execution_keys))) AS g0,
    time_unix_nano AS t, sample_id,
    intDiv(time_unix_nano, {step:UInt64}) * {step:UInt64} AS bucket, if(bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0,
    if(isNull(int_value), double_value, toFloat64(int_value)), NULL) AS v
  FROM (SELECT points.*, arraySort(arrayDistinct(arrayMap(m -> m.1,
    arrayFilter(m -> resource_kind = 4 AND time_unix_nano >= m.2 AND
      if(m.4 = 0, time_unix_nano <= m.3, time_unix_nano < m.4), memberships)))) AS execution_keys
  FROM (SELECT *, series_id FROM metric_points FINAL
  WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}) AS points
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT node_id AS membership_node, assumeNotNull(process_resource_id) AS membership_resource,
      groupArray(tuple(execution_key, first_seen_unix_nano, last_seen_unix_nano,
        ifNull(ended_unix_nano, toUInt64(0)))) AS memberships
    FROM (
      SELECT * FROM execution_participants FINAL WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    )
    WHERE NOT retracted AND kind = 2 AND process_resource_id IS NOT NULL
      AND first_seen_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
      AND if(isNull(ended_unix_nano), last_seen_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64}, ended_unix_nano > {from:UInt64})
    GROUP BY membership_node, membership_resource
  ) AS membership_sets
  ON points.source_id = membership_node AND points.resource_id = membership_resource)
  WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
    AND metric_name = {p0:String} AND CAST(metric_kind, 'Int16') = {p1:Int16}
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT series, g0, bucket, v - lagInFrame(v) OVER w AS d, row_number() OVER w AS n
  FROM base WHERE v IS NOT NULL
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY stream, g0 ORDER BY t, sample_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
per_series AS (
  SELECT series, g0, bucket, sum(greatest(d, 0)) / ((least(bucket + {step:UInt64}, {to:UInt64}) - greatest(bucket, {from:UInt64})) / 1e9) AS value FROM diffs WHERE n > 1 GROUP BY series, g0, bucket
),
combined AS (
  SELECT g0, bucket, sum(value) AS value,
    NULL AS low, NULL AS high, count(per_series.value) AS sources
  FROM per_series GROUP BY g0, bucket
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY weight DESC, g0) AS rank
  FROM (SELECT *, sum(abs(value)) OVER (PARTITION BY g0) AS weight FROM combined)
)
SELECT g0 AS k_g0, 0 AS other, toString(bucket) AS bucket_ns, value AS series_value, rank AS series_rank,
  low AS series_low, high AS series_high, sources AS series_sources
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= {seriesLimit:UInt32} + 1

queries.name: execution_memory_table
queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT series_id AS series, stream_id AS stream,
    resource_id AS g0,
    time_unix_nano AS t, sample_id,
    toUInt64(0) AS bucket, if(bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0,
    if(isNull(int_value), double_value, toFloat64(int_value)), NULL) AS v
  FROM (SELECT points.*, arraySort(arrayDistinct(arrayMap(m -> m.1,
    arrayFilter(m -> resource_kind = 4 AND time_unix_nano >= m.2 AND
      if(m.4 = 0, time_unix_nano <= m.3, time_unix_nano < m.4), memberships)))) AS execution_keys
  FROM (SELECT *, series_id FROM metric_points FINAL
  WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}) AS points
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT node_id AS membership_node, assumeNotNull(process_resource_id) AS membership_resource,
      groupArray(tuple(execution_key, first_seen_unix_nano, last_seen_unix_nano,
        ifNull(ended_unix_nano, toUInt64(0)))) AS memberships
    FROM (
      SELECT * FROM execution_participants FINAL WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    )
    WHERE NOT retracted AND kind = 2 AND process_resource_id IS NOT NULL
      AND first_seen_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
      AND if(isNull(ended_unix_nano), last_seen_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64}, ended_unix_nano > {from:UInt64})
    GROUP BY membership_node, membership_resource
  ) AS membership_sets
  ON points.source_id = membership_node AND points.resource_id = membership_resource)
  WHERE project_id = {project:String}
    AND event_day >= {firstDay:UInt32} AND event_day <= {lastDay:UInt32}
    AND time_unix_nano >= {from:UInt64} AND time_unix_nano < {to:UInt64}
    AND metric_name = {p1:String} AND CAST(metric_kind, 'Int16') = {p2:Int16}
    AND hasAny(execution_keys, {p0:Array(String)})
),
per_series AS (
  SELECT series, g0, bucket, max(v) AS value FROM base WHERE v IS NOT NULL GROUP BY series, g0, bucket
),
combined AS (
  SELECT g0, bucket, quantileExact(0.95)(value) AS value,
    NULL AS low, NULL AS high, count(per_series.value) AS sources
  FROM per_series GROUP BY g0, bucket
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY weight DESC, g0) AS rank
  FROM (SELECT *, sum(abs(value)) OVER (PARTITION BY g0) AS weight FROM combined)
)
SELECT g0 AS k_g0, 0 AS other, toString(bucket) AS bucket_ns, value AS series_value, rank AS series_rank,
  low AS series_low, high AS series_high, sources AS series_sources
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= {seriesLimit:UInt32} + 1
